limitations: Matte constant displayColor; material graphs and textures are not evaluated
Uniform untextured domes are invisible to camera rays
Sphere lights require uniform scale without shear; treatAsPoint is unsupported
Light textures, shaping, filters, linking and shadow overrides are unsupported
Instancing and subdivision are unsupported; analytic primitive adapters are not assessed
Diagnostic AOVs use pixel-center hits; instanceId is -1 for uninstanced geometry

aov_semantics.cameraDepth: Ray distance from eye (perspective) or near plane (orthographic), scene units, miss 0
aov_semantics.albedo: Matte constant displayColor, miss/analytic emitter black
